alternatives_and_negative_results: Do not waive them, reinterpret the 600 m theoretical c/(2B) as measured resolution, or claim single-target Pd as two-target resolution.
applicability: S05 architecture, buffer/telemetry interfaces and later SCR/range-resolution verification.
assessed_root_cause: The current input population does not span the required clutter amplitudes, phase behavior, measurement region or paired-target resolution cases.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Carry both requirements in the S05 traceability matrix; reserve input headroom/telemetry and preserve full range-Doppler/power outputs and cluster records needed for future scoring.
generalizable_lesson: An architecture may proceed in parallel, but unresolved requirements must remain visible and their data/telemetry impacts must be designed in.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: A clean single-target or noise-only PASS could be interpreted as closure of clutter dynamic range or two-target separability.
non_applicability: Does not define the final SCR tolerance, clutter phase envelope or resolved-pair criterion; these remain to be approved.
observable_consequence: REQ-SCR-01 and REQ-RNG-03 remain binding and not executed; the C06 final report and C02 open-obligations file explicitly preserve them.
observed_problem: Current C06R2 covers only NOISE_ONLY_UNIT/g5 and SINGLE_TARGET_REFERENCE_LIKE_LAB/g1; it does not test +/-10 dB SCR/clutter or paired targets near 600 m.
repeatable_validation: Approve separate generator envelopes and success metrics, then execute separately authorized tests and retain raw truth/output evidence.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: Keep REQ-SCR-01 and REQ-RNG-03 OPEN; no implicit waiver or closure.
title: Keep SCR and two-target resolution as binding open requirements with explicit architecture impacts
